verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt is served (HTTP 200) on docs.mozilla.ai, the site that hosts llamafile's documentation, so an agent has an agent-oriented entry point. However, the visible excerpt lists only the any-llm section, so it is not shown whether llamafile pages are indexed. The probe for the llamafile .md page returned 'Page Not Found'. missing for 10: confirmed llamafile entries in llms.txt, working per-page markdown docs for llamafile, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: llamafile lets you distribute and run LLMs with a single file.
